none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable objectives f: ℝ^d → ℝ with L-Lipschitz gradient and f(x0)−inf f≤Δ. Convexity is not required. All parameters d,L,M,ν,σ,Δ,ε,x0 are public; the objective and oracle distribution are hidden.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: One call queries a pair (x,y) and returns (g(x,ξ),g(y,ξ)) using the same sample ξ∈Bool. Samples are IID across calls. The estimator is unbiased at every point. Each paired response counts as one oracle call; neither function values nor the sample itself are returned.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HolderNoiseNonconvexLower.lean: LowerParams.toParams, spec.Query, spec.Reply; LongTails/Setups/HolderNoiseNonconvex.lean: spec.admissible oracle equality and unbiasedness; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace.

distinctive_assumptions.label: gradient_similarity
distinctive_assumptions.details: Centered noise increments satisfy E‖[g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)]−[g(y,ξ)−∇f(y)]‖²≤M‖x−y‖^(2ν) globally, where M≥0 and 0<ν≤1. This condition concerns noise increments rather than Hölder smoothness of the objective gradient.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HolderNoiseNonconvex.lean: spec.valid and final condition of spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x, E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖²≤σ², with σ≥0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Euclidean space ℝ^d, with 64ε²≤LΔ and d≥⌈2³⁰(1+LΔ/ε²)³(1+σ²/ε²)⌉; L>0 and ε>0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The sample space is restricted to Bool, with an unspecified probability distribution. Algorithms may be randomized and adapt queries to prior replies; no additional algorithm restriction is specified.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HolderNoiseNonconvexLower.lean: LowerParams.toParams and spec; LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm and Setup.allowedAlgorithm.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: Return a measurable point X∈ℝ^d with integrable gradient norm satisfying E‖∇f(X)‖≤ε. The criterion uses the first power of the norm and does not require X to be a queried point.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Expectation includes algorithm and oracle randomness.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HolderNoiseNonconvex.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence product probability law.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The stationarity benchmark is standard, but this formulation combines a shared-sample paired oracle, globally Hölder-controlled centered noise increments, a binary sample space, and an explicit high-dimensional lower-bound regime.
